name: @lumi.ai/relay
description: Browser relay — holds one WebSocket per connected browser so agents can drive it. Pluggable auth; presence and dispatch only.
//public: PUBLIC PACKAGE, PUBLIC SOURCE. It lived in a private repo while it was Lumi infrastructure; it is side 2 of the open suite now and the source is here. The npm NAME is still @lumi.ai/relay — renaming it would change every install command and force a reinstall on every box, and that is a decision to take once, deliberately, not a side effect of moving a directory.
author: CodeBridger

scripts.//prepublishOnly: dist/ is gitignored and `files` ships only it, so a publish from a fresh checkout that skipped the build would produce a tarball whose `bin` points at a file that is not in it — installable, and broken on every invocation. Runs on `npm publish` only, never on `npm ci`.
scripts.//test:unit: Typecheck the tests, THEN run them — crew-shared's pattern. The build tsconfig excludes `src/**/*.test.ts` because `dist/` is published, and excluded from the build means excluded from `tsc --noEmit` too; without the first half the tests are the one part of the package nothing type-checks.
scripts.//build: CLEAN FIRST. `tsc` never deletes, so a file removed from src/ lingers in dist/ forever on a working copy — and `check-browser-ticket-parity.mjs` imports dist/ by path. Moving ticket.ts under providers/ left a stale dist/ticket.js that the guard would have kept verifying, green, against code no longer in the repo. CI never sees it (fresh checkout); a laptop always does.

//deps: Everything here must resolve from the PUBLIC registry, since `npm i -g` installs it on a machine with no access to this repo. The relay deliberately depends on no @lumi/* package: it is presence and dispatch, it holds no Crew types, and keeping it standalone is what lets it be built and published without the rest of the monorepo.
//version: DERIVED, not typed. scripts/resolve-relay-version.mjs walks the commits since the last release; the value here is only a seed for a first publish. Do not bump it by hand — see .github/workflows/release-relay.yml.
